# How to
Find the description and installing instructions in the [README.md](README.md).
Set up the current configureation in the [llm_config.json](llm_config.json).
Add `.key` files to use the repo with external API, if not, then use withh local LLM server.
Set up the evaluation method in [evaluation.json](evaluation.json).
For primary/secondary scoring, weights, review thresholds and audit fields, see [TWO_STAGE_SCORING.md](TWO_STAGE_SCORING.md).
